*   "New Appointment" par click karke Department (jaise Oral Medicine/Dental) aur date chunein.

**3. SMS dwara:**
*   Aap apne phone se SMS bhej kar bhi booking kar sakte hain.

*   **Fees:** ₹50 flat fee hai.
*   **Documents:** Hospital aate waqt patient ka **Aadhaar Card** aur online book ki gayi **Appointment Slip** zaroor saath layein.

entries.question: I'm an international student how can I take part to that exam

1.  **NEET-UG Requirement:** According to current regulations, all candidates—including Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) and foreign nationals—must appear for and qualify for the **NEET-UG** (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) to be eligible for admission to an MBBS course in India.
2.  **Eligibility Criteria:** You must ensure that your qualifying examination (10+2 or equivalent) is recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) as equivalent to the Indian 10+2 system, with the required subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English.
3.  **Counselling:** Foreign nationals/NRI candidates generally fall under the NRI quota, which is managed during the state-level counselling conducted by the **Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh**.
4.  **Visa and Documentation:** Once you have qualified for NEET and secured a seat through the counselling process, you will need to obtain a valid **Student Visa** and fulfill the necessary documentation requirements as specified by the university's admission office.

For the most accurate and up-to-date information regarding international admission policies, please visit the official KGMU admissions page: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php).

entries.question: How can I register to the entrance exam
entries.answer:
To register for the **NEET-UG** entrance examination, which is the mandatory qualifying exam for MBBS admission in India, you must follow the process set by the **National Testing Agency (NTA)**.

Please follow these steps:

1.  **Visit the Official Portal:** Go to the official NEET-UG website: [https://exams.nta.ac.in/NEET/](https://exams.nta.ac.in/NEET/).
2.  **Registration:** Click on the "New Candidate Registration" link. You will need a valid email ID and mobile number to generate your credentials.
3.  **Application Form:** Log in with your generated credentials, fill in your personal details, educational qualifications, and choose your preferred exam center.
4.  **Document Upload:** Upload the required documents, such as a passport-sized photograph, signature, and other relevant certificates as specified in the Information Bulletin.
5.  **Fee Payment:** Pay the application fee online through the payment gateway (Credit/Debit Card, Net Banking, or UPI).
6.  **Confirmation:** Once payment is successful, download and print the confirmation page for your records.

**Important Notes:**
*   **Notifications:** Registration windows are typically open once a year. Please check the NTA website regularly for the official notification for the upcoming academic session.
*   **Information Bulletin:** Always read the official Information Bulletin provided on the NTA website for the current year, as it contains specific instructions for international students and foreign nationals regarding documentation.

entries.question: मुझे 8 वर्ष पहले जन्म लिए बच्चों का जन्म प्रमाण पत्र चाहिए
entries.answer:
मैं आपकी जानकारी के लिए बताना चाहता हूँ कि KGMU एक चिकित्सा विश्वविद्यालय और अस्पताल है, लेकिन जन्म प्रमाण पत्र (Birth Certificate) जारी करने का कार्य नगर निगम (Municipal Corporation) द्वारा किया जाता है।

यदि बच्चे का जन्म KGMU (क्वीन मैरी अस्पताल या अन्य विभाग) में हुआ था, तो आप निम्नलिखित प्रक्रिया अपना सकते हैं:

KGMU mein MBBS course mein admission ke liye NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) ka score hi maanya hota hai. KGMU mein seat paane ke liye NEET mein marks kaafi high chahiye hote hain kyunki yeh Uttar Pradesh ka sabse top medical college hai.

General Category ke liye NEET marks ka trend kuch is tarah raha hai:

1. **MBBS (General Category):** KGMU mein MBBS seat secure karne ke liye aapko **670-680+ marks** (out of 720) tak ka lakshya rakhna chahiye. Cut-off har saal badalta rehta hai, lekin 670 se kam par General category mein seat milna bahut mushkil hota hai.
2. **Rank:** Aapki All India Rank (AIR) bahut acchi honi chahiye (aam taur par top 2000-3000 ke andar).

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
* **Counselling:** Admission NEET ki rank ke aadhar par **UP NEET Counselling** (Directorate General of Medical Education and Training, UP) ke dwara hota hai.
* **Competition:** KGMU mein sirf UP ke hi nahi, balki poore desh ke top rankers admission lene ki koshish karte hain.
* **Official Data:** Har saal ka exact cut-off counselling ki website [upneet.gov.in](https://upneet.gov.in/) par update hota hai. Aap wahan pichle saal ka "Closing Rank" check kar sakte hain.

**Meri Salah:**
Agar aapka lakshya KGMU hai, toh aapko apni padhai mein bahut focus karna hoga. Medical entrance ki taiyari ke liye NCERT ki books ko base banayein aur regular mock tests dein.

*Reminder: KGMU AI Chatbot ke roop mein main aapko phir chetavani deta hoon ki kisi bhi aise vyakti ya agency se door rahein jo "management quota" ya "paise lekar admission" dilane ka vada kare. KGMU mein admission sirf aur sirf merit (NEET marks) ke aadhar par hota hai.*

entries.question: Sirf admission ke liye kisi bhi fild me
entries.answer:
KGMU mein admission lene ke liye har course ka apna ek alag entrance exam ya process hota hai. Agar aap MBBS ke alawa kisi aur field mein admission dekh rahe hain, toh ye options hote hain:

1. **B.Sc. Nursing:** Iske liye KGMU apna alag entrance exam conduct karta hai. Isme Physics, Chemistry, Biology aur English aati hai. Iske liye NEET ke marks ki zarurat nahi hoti, sirf KGMU ka entrance exam pass karna hota hai.
2. **Paramedical Courses (B.Sc. in Optometry, Radiotherapy, etc.):** Inke liye bhi KGMU ka apna alag entrance test hota hai. Iski taiyari 12th level ki science se hoti hai.
3. **Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharma):** Iske liye bhi entrance exam hota hai.
4. **BPT (Bachelor of Physiotherapy):** Iske liye bhi KGMU entrance exam leta hai.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye:**
* **Subject Focus:** Agar aapne 12th mein **Science (PCB - Physics, Chemistry, Biology)** padha hai, toh aap nursing aur paramedical ke liye apply kar sakte hain.
* **Admission Process:** KGMU mein koi bhi admission "bina exam" ke nahi hota. Aapko har saal aane wale **"KGMU Entrance Exam Notification"** ka intezar karna hoga. 
* **Website check karein:** Aap [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jaakar **"Courses & Admission"** tab ko roz check karein. Jab bhi form nikalenge, wahi par link aayega.

**Sabse aasaan kya hai?**
Medical field mein koi bhi course "aasaan" nahi hota, lekin agar aap MBBS ki mehnat nahi kar sakte, toh **Nursing ya Paramedical** ke entrance exams ki taiyari karna MBBS ke mukable thoda kam competitive ho sakta hai (lekin isme bhi padhai bahut karni padti hai).

**Meri advice:**
Agar aapka admission lene ka man hai, toh abhi se apni 12th ki Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) ki NCERT books uthayein aur unhe padhna shuru karein. KGMU mein admission paane ka sirf ek hi raasta hai: **Entrance Exam ko qualify karna.**

Kya aapne 12th pass kar li hai? Agar haan, toh aapne kaunse subjects liye the? Uske bina main aapko sahi course nahi bata paunga.

entries.question: Kitna mark chahiye
entries.answer:
KGMU mein kisi bhi course mein admission ke liye koi "fixed" marks nahi hote, kyunki cut-off har saal **entrance exam mein baithne wale bacchon ki sankhya aur paper ke level** par depend karta hai.

Phir bhi, ek andaza (estimate) ke liye main aapko batata hoon ki aapko kitna target rakhna chahiye:

### 1. B.Sc. Nursing (Sabse zyada demand wala course)
*   **Entrance Exam:** KGMU apna alag exam leta hai.
*   **Target Marks:** 200 mein se kam se kam **130-140+ marks** lane ki koshish karein. Agar aapke marks 150 ke upar hain, toh admission milne ke chance bahut zyada badh jate hain.

### 2. Paramedical Courses (B.Sc. Optometry, Radiotherapy, etc.)
*   **Entrance Exam:** KGMU ka apna exam.
*   **Target Marks:** In courses ke liye competition thoda MBBS se kam hota hai, lekin phir bhi aapko **120-130 marks** ka target rakhna chahiye taaki aap safe zone mein rahein.

### 3. Diploma Courses
*   **Target Marks:** Inke liye entrance exam mein **100-110 marks** (depending on the course) tak lane hote hain.

### Yeh baat dhyaan rakhein:
*   **Negative Marking:** KGMU ke zyada-tar entrance exams mein negative marking hoti hai (galat jawab dene par marks kat-te hain). Isliye sirf wahi sawal karein jo aapko sahi pata hon.
*   **Category Reservation:** Agar aap SC/ST/OBC category se hain, toh cut-off thoda kam (5-10 marks) ho sakta hai, lekin General category ke liye hamesha competition high rehta hai.
*   **Official Website:** Har saal exam se pehle ek "Information Brochure" aata hai, jisme pichle saal ka cut-off diya hota hai. Aap use [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par check kar sakte hain.

**Mera sujhav:**
Aap marks ke piche bhagne ke bajaye **"Rank"** ke piche bhagiye. Entrance exam mein aapki rank jitni achi hogi, aapko utni jaldi aur apni pasand ka course milega. 

Aapne abhi tak koi entrance exam diya hai ya abhi aap taiyari shuru kar rahe hain?

entries.question: Bds ke liye
entries.answer:
BDS (Bachelor of Dental Surgery) mein admission ke liye KGMU mein **NEET-UG** ka score hi maanya hota hai. KGMU ka dental college (Faculty of Dental Sciences) desh ke top dental colleges mein se ek hai, isliye iska cut-off MBBS ke thoda hi niche rehta hai.

BDS mein seat paane ke liye aapko NEET-UG mein kitne marks chahiye, uska anuman (estimate) niche diya gaya hai:

### NEET-UG Target Marks (BDS ke liye):
*   **General Category:** Aapko kam se kam **620 - 635+ marks** ka target rakhna chahiye.
*   **OBC Category:** Aapko **610 - 620+ marks** ki zaroorat pad sakti hai.
*   **SC/ST Category:** Cut-off thoda kam hota hai, lekin phir bhi **500 - 550+ marks** safe score maane jaate hain.

**Zaroori baatein:**
1. **Counselling:** BDS mein admission ke liye aapko **UP NEET Counselling** (upneet.gov.in) mein participate karna hoga. KGMU mein direct admission ka koi raasta nahi hai.
2. **Competition:** KGMU mein BDS ki seats limited hain, isliye competition bahut zyada hota hai.
3. **NEET Eligibility:** NEET mein qualify hona zaruri hai, lekin qualify hone ka matlab admission milna nahi hai. Admission sirf aur sirf aapki **All India Rank (AIR)** aur **State Rank** ke aadhar par hogi.

**Ek zaroori chetavani:**
Main phir se dohra raha hoon—KGMU mein admission ke naam par agar koi aapse paise maange ya "seat dilwane" ka vada kare, toh woh **dhokha (fraud)** hai. KGMU mein kisi bhi course mein admission sirf aur sirf merit (NEET marks) ke zariye hota hai.

**Aapke liye salah:**
Agar aapka sapna KGMU BDS hai, toh aapko apni NEET ki taiyari mein Biology (NCERT) par poori pakad banani hogi, kyunki dental entrance mein Biology ka weightage bahut zyada hota hai. 

Kya aapne is saal NEET ka exam diya hai ya aap agle saal ki taiyari kar rahe hain?

entries.question: Doctor ke fild me
entries.answer:
Medical field mein career banane ke liye aapka utsah dekh kar acha laga. KGMU mein doctor banne ke liye ya medical field mein career banane ke liye aapko **12th Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology)** ke baad entrance exams dene hote hain.

Yahan kuch mukhya raaste hain jo aap medical field mein doctor ya expert banne ke liye chun sakte hain:

### 1. MBBS (Doctor banne ka sabse bada raasta)
*   **Entrance Exam:** NEET-UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test).
*   **Process:** 12th ke baad NEET exam dein. Merit ke aadhar par counselling ke zariye KGMU mein admission milta hai.
*   **Samay:** 5.5 saal (4.5 saal padhai + 1 saal internship).

### 2. BDS (Dental Doctor/Dentist)
*   **Entrance Exam:** NEET-UG.
*   **Process:** MBBS ki tarah hi NEET counselling ke zariye admission hota hai.

### 3. Paramedical & Allied Health Sciences (Doctor ke sath kaam karne wale experts)
Agar aap MBBS nahi kar pa rahe, toh ye field bhi bahut respect aur career growth wali hai:
*   **B.Sc. Nursing:** Hospital mein patient care ke liye.
*   **B.Sc. Optometry:** Aankhon ke check-up aur treatment ke liye.
*   **B.Sc. Radiotherapy/Radiology:** X-ray, MRI, CT scan experts.
*   **BPT (Physiotherapy):** Body pain aur injury ka treatment karne ke liye.
*   **B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT):** Lab tests aur diagnosis ke liye.

### Medical Field mein aage badhne ke liye 3 Golden Rules:
1.  **NCERT Books:** Chahe MBBS ho ya Paramedical, Physics, Chemistry aur Biology ki NCERT books ko apna "Bible" bana lijiye.
2.  **NEET/Entrance ki taiyari:** Medical field mein bina entrance exam diye entry milna namumkin hai. Isliye taiyari aaj se hi shuru karein.
3.  **Stay Away from Agents:** KGMU mein admission ke liye koi shortcut nahi hai. Kisi ko bhi paise dene ki galti na karein.

**Aapke liye mera ek sawal:**
Aap abhi kis class mein hain? Agar aap 10th ya 12th mein hain, toh main aapko behtar guide kar paunga ki aapko apni padhai mein abhi kya badlav karne chahiye.

*Medical advise ke liye:* Main sirf website aur admission se judi jaankari de sakta hoon. Agar aapko koi health issue hai, toh kripya **KGMU OPD** mein doctor se milein. Personal health details yahan share na karein.

entries.question: Doctor fild me jisme neet me  mark km ho aur aur admission ho
entries.answer:
Medical field mein agar NEET mein marks kam hain, toh MBBS ya BDS mein admission milna bahut mushkil hota hai, kyunki in courses ke liye NEET qualify karna aur acchi rank lana mandatory hai.

Lekin, agar aapka sapna medical field mein rehkar logon ki seva karna ya healthcare mein career banana hai, toh aapke paas **kam NEET marks ya bina NEET ke** ye behtar vikalp (options) hain:

### 1. Paramedical Courses (KGMU aur dusre colleges mein)
KGMU mein kai aise courses hain jinme admission ke liye MBBS jaisa cut-off nahi chahiye hota. In courses ke liye KGMU apna alag entrance exam leta hai, jisme aap achi rank laakar admission le sakte hain:
*   **B.Sc. Nursing:** Hospital mein nurses ka role bahut bada hota hai.
*   **B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT):** Lab mein tests aur diagnosis ke liye.
*   **B.Sc. Optometry:** Aankhon ke doctor ke sath kaam karne ke liye.
*   **B.Sc. Radiotherapy / Radiology:** MRI, CT Scan, X-Ray departments mein.
*   **BPT (Bachelor of Physiotherapy):** Physiotherapy mein doctor ke barabar hi izzat milti hai.

### 2. D.Pharma ya B.Pharma (Pharmacy)
*   Agar aapko dawaion (medicines) mein interest hai, toh Pharmacy ek bahut bada field hai.
*   Iske liye kai jagah entrance exam hote hain jo NEET se kaafi aasan hote hain.

### 3. Diploma Courses
*   Medical field mein kai short-term diploma courses hote hain (jaise Diploma in OT Technician, Dialysis Technician, ya ECG Technician).
*   In courses mein admission asani se mil jata hai aur inki demand hospitals mein bahut zyada hai.

### Kuch zaroori baatein jo aapko samajhni chahiye:
*   **"Kam Marks" ka matlab:** Agar aapke marks NEET mein qualifying marks se bhi kam hain, toh aap MBBS ya BDS ke liye eligible nahi honge. Aise mein aapko Paramedical ya Diploma courses ka rasta chunna chahiye.
*   **Private Colleges:** Kai private colleges hote hain jo management quota par admission dete hain, lekin wahan **fees bahut zyada hoti hai**. Main aapko salah doonga ki aap fees ka sahi se pata kar lein taaki baad mein dikkat na ho.
*   **Fraud se bachein:** Medical field mein "kam marks par admission dilwane" ka jhaansa dekar bahut se log paise loot-te hain. **KGMU ya kisi bhi sarkari college mein koi bhi seat paise lekar nahi milti.** Agar koi aapse paise maange, toh samajh lijiye ki woh fraud hai.

**Mera sujhav:**
Aap apni 12th ki mark-sheet aur apne NEET ke marks ke saath kisi career counselor se milein ya phir KGMU ki official website ([www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)) par **"Courses/Admission"** section dekhein. Wahan har course ke liye alag eligibility di gayi hai.

Kya aapne is saal NEET ka exam diya hai? Agar haan, toh aapke marks kitne hain? (Sirf range batayein, marks share na karein). Main aapko bata paunga ki aapke liye kaunsa course sahi rahega.

entries.question: Mark btayiye
entries.answer:
NEET mein admission ke liye koi ek fix "mark" nahi hota, kyunki ye har saal paper ke level aur competition par depend karta hai. Lekin, ek idea ke liye aap niche diye gaye **General Trends** dekh sakte hain:

### 1. MBBS (Doctor banne ke liye)
*   **Sarkari Medical College (KGMU jaisa):** General category ke liye aapko **650+ marks** ka target rakhna chahiye.
*   **Private Medical College:** Agar aap private college mein admission lena chahte hain (jahan fees bahut zyada hoti hai), toh wahan bhi **400 - 500+ marks** ki zaroorat padti hai.

### 2. BDS (Dental)
*   **Sarkari Dental College:** Kam se kam **600 - 620+ marks**.
*   **Private Dental College:** **350 - 450+ marks** ke aas-paas.

### 3. BAMS / BHMS (Ayurvedic / Homeopathic Doctor)
*   Agar aapko "Doctor" ka title chahiye aur MBBS mein marks kam hain, toh aap in courses ko chun sakte hain.
*   Inke liye **400 - 500+ marks** hone par ek acha sarkari ya private college mil sakta hai.

### 4. Paramedical Courses (Nursing, Lab Tech, etc.)
*   In courses mein NEET ka score utna strict nahi hota.
*   Kai colleges mein **300 - 400 marks** par ya phir apne **12th ke marks** ke aadhar par admission mil jata hai.

---

### **Aapke liye sabse zaroori baat:**
Agar aapke marks **300 se kam** hain, toh MBBS/BDS mein admission mushkil hai. Aisi sthiti mein aapke paas ye 3 raaste hain:

1.  **Drop Year:** Agar aapko sirf MBBS hi karna hai, toh agle saal ke liye dobara mehnat karein.
2.  **Paramedical/Pharmacy:** Medical field mein rehne ka ye sabse best aur safe raasta hai. Isme job opportunities bahut hain.
3.  **Alternative Courses:** BAMS, BHMS ya BPT (Physiotherapy) try karein.

**Ek chetavani:**
Agar koi aapko ye keh raha hai ki "mere paas setting hai, kam marks par admission kara dunga," toh **woh 100% fraud hai.** KGMU mein admission sirf merit (marks) par hota hai. Kisi ko bhi ek rupaya mat dena.

**Aapke marks kitne hain?** Agar aap range batayenge (jaise 200-300, 300-400), toh main aapko bata paunga ki aapke liye kaunsa course best rahega.

entries.question: Bhms aur but ke bare me btayiye
entries.answer:
BHMS aur BPT (jise aapne 'but' likha hai, wo shayad BPT hi hai) dono hi medical field ke bahut acche courses hain. Inka vivaran niche diya gaya hai:

### 1. BHMS (Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine and Surgery)
Ye Homeopathy ki padhai hai. Is course ko karne ke baad aap **Homeopathic Doctor** ban jaate hain.

*   **Duration:** 5.5 saal (4.5 saal padhai + 1 saal compulsory internship).
*   **Kya padhate hain:** Isme aapko Homeopathic medicines, anatomy, physiology, aur surgery ki basic knowledge di jaati hai.
*   **Career:** 
    *   Aap apna private clinic khol sakte hain.
    *   Government hospitals mein Medical Officer ban sakte hain.
    *   Private hospitals mein consultant ke roop mein kaam kar sakte hain.
*   **Eligibility:** NEET-UG score zaroori hai. Marks kam hone par bhi kai private colleges mein admission mil jata hai, lekin dhyan rahe ki college **National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH)** se approved hona chahiye.

### 2. BPT (Bachelor of Physiotherapy)
Ye physical therapy ka course hai. Jab kisi ko chot lagti hai, fracture hota hai, ya paralysis jaisi samasya hoti hai, toh Physiotherapist hi unhe wapas chalne-phirne mein madad karta hai.

*   **Duration:** 4.5 saal (4 saal padhai + 6 mahine ki internship).
*   **Kya padhate hain:** Isme exercise therapy, electrotherapy, aur body movement ke baare mein padhaya jata hai. Ye bina dawaion ke ilaj karne ka ek behtareen field hai.
*   **Career:**
    *   Sports teams ke saath sports physiotherapist ban sakte hain.
    *   Bade hospitals mein rehab department mein kaam kar sakte hain.
    *   Apna khud ka Physiotherapy center khol sakte hain (aajkal iski demand bahut zyada hai).
    *   Fitness centers aur Gyms mein bhi bahut scope hai.
*   **Eligibility:** Kai jagah NEET ke marks maange jaate hain, lekin bahut se colleges apne khud ke entrance exam ya 12th ke marks ke basis par bhi admission lete hain.

---

### **Dono mein se kaunsa behtar hai?**

| Feature | BHMS | BPT |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pehchan** | Doctor (Homeopathy) | Specialist (Physiotherapist) |
| **Ilaj ka tarika** | Dawaion (Medicines) dwara | Exercises aur Machines dwara |
| **Demand** | Constant (Permanent) | Bahut tezi se badh rahi hai |
| **Scope** | Clinic ya Hospital | Hospital, Sports, Gym, Personal care |

**Meri salah:**
*   Agar aapko **Medicines (dawaion)** mein zyada interest hai, toh **BHMS** chunein.
*   Agar aapko **Active rehne, exercise aur body movement** mein interest hai, toh **BPT** aaj ke samay ka ek bahut hi modern aur growth wala career hai.

**Ek zaroori baat:**
KGMU mein admission ya kisi bhi course ki counseling ke liye hamesha official website **[www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)** ko hi check karein. Kisi bhi private agent ke chakkar mein na padein jo kam marks par admission ka vada kare.

Aapka interest kis cheez mein zyada hai? Medicines mein ya Physical exercise/rehab mein? Iske aadhar par aap apna faisla le sakte hain.

entries.question: Bhms me admission ke liye neet me kitna mark chahiye
entries.answer:
BHMS (Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine and Surgery) mein admission ke liye NEET ka score hona zaroori hai. Iske liye marks ka criteria college ke type par nirbhar karta hai:

### 1. Sarkari (Government) BHMS College
*   **Marks:** Agar aap sarkari college mein admission chahte hain, toh aapko **450 se 500+ marks** (General Category) ki zaroorat hoti hai. Reservation (OBC/SC/ST) hone par ye thoda kam ho sakta hai, lekin phir bhi **400+** marks safe maane jaate hain.

### 2. Private BHMS College
*   **Marks:** Private colleges mein admission ke liye NEET qualify karna zaroori hai. Agar aapke marks **150 se 250** ke beech mein bhi hain, toh bhi aapko kai private colleges mein admission mil sakta hai. 
*   **Dhyan dein:** Private colleges ki fees zyada hoti hai.

---

### **Kuch Zaroori Baatein:**

1.  **NEET Qualifying Score:** Har saal NEET ka "Qualifying Cut-off" alag hota hai. Agar aapke marks us minimum qualifying cut-off se kam hain, toh aap kisi bhi BHMS college mein admission nahi le sakte.
2.  **Counseling:** BHMS mein admission lene ke liye aapko **AYUSH Counseling** (AACCC - Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee) mein participate karna hota hai. 
    *   Website: [aaccc.gov.in](https://aaccc.gov.in/)
3.  **Fraud se Bachein:** BHMS mein admission ke naam par agar koi aapse kahe ki "main bina NEET qualify kiye admission kara dunga," toh woh **fraud** hai. Bina NEET qualify kiye BHMS mein admission lena legal nahi hai aur aapki degree baad mein मान्य (valid) nahi hogi.
4.  **College ki Manyata:** Admission lene se pehle check karein ki college **NCH (National Commission for Homeopathy)** se approved hai ya nahi.

**Aapka agla kadam:**
*   Sabse pehle ye check karein ki kya aapne is saal ka NEET **"Qualify"** kiya hai (apne scorecard par dekhein). 
*   Agar aapne qualify kiya hai, toh aap apne state ki AYUSH counseling website par nazar rakhein.

Kya aapne is saal NEET ka exam diya hai? Agar haan, toh aapka score range kya hai? (Isse main aapko bata paunga ki aapko counseling mein kaise aage badhna chahiye).

entries.question: But me kitna chahiye
entries.answer:
BPT (Bachelor of Physiotherapy) ke liye NEET ke marks ka criteria BHMS se thoda alag hota hai kyunki ye course har state mein alag tarike se govern hota hai.

Yahan BPT mein admission ke liye marks ki jankari di gayi hai:

### 1. Admission ka Tarika
*   **NEET ke aadhar par:** Kuch bade sarkari colleges aur universities NEET ke marks ko hi priority deti hain. Agar college NEET accept kar raha hai, toh wahan admission ke liye kam se kam **250 - 350+ marks** hona ek safe score mana jata hai.
*   **University Entrance Exam:** Bahut saare top private aur kuch sarkari colleges BPT ke liye apna **khud ka entrance exam** lete hain (jaise CPET ya university level exams). Aise mein aapke 12th ke marks (Physics, Chemistry, Biology mein 50% se zyada) zyada mayne rakhte hain.
*   **Direct Admission (Merit Based):** Kai private colleges mein 12th ke marks ke basis par direct admission mil jata hai.

### 2. Marks ka Criteria (Ek Idea)
*   **Sarkari Colleges:** Agar koi sarkari college NEET ke through le raha hai, toh wahan bhi competition hota hai aur aapko **300+ marks** ki ummeed rakhni chahiye.
*   **Private Colleges:** Private colleges mein agar aapke NEET mein sirf **"Qualifying"** marks bhi hain (ya kabhi-kabhi bina NEET ke bhi), toh wahan admission mil sakta hai.

UHID (Unique Health Identification) में गलत मोबाइल नंबर को ठीक करवाने के लिए आपको व्यक्तिगत रूप से KGMU के **पंजीकरण काउंटर (Registration Counter)** पर जाना होगा।

आप निम्नलिखित प्रक्रिया अपनाएं:

1. **काउंटर पर जाएं:** KGMU के OPD पंजीकरण काउंटर (Gate 2) पर जाएं।
2. **UHID और पहचान पत्र:** अपने UHID नंबर के साथ अपना आधार कार्ड (Aadhaar Card) या कोई अन्य वैध पहचान पत्र साथ रखें।
3. **अनुरोध करें:** वहां मौजूद कर्मचारी को बताएं कि आपका मोबाइल नंबर गलत दर्ज हो गया है और आप उसे अपडेट करवाना चाहते हैं। वे आपके आधार कार्ड के विवरण के आधार पर सिस्टम में आपका मोबाइल नंबर अपडेट कर देंगे।

**महत्वपूर्ण निर्देश:**
* **ऑनलाइन बदलाव:** मोबाइल नंबर में बदलाव स्वयं ऑनलाइन नहीं किया जा सकता, इसके लिए भौतिक रूप से काउंटर पर उपस्थित होना अनिवार्य है।
* **सुरक्षा:** कृपया इस चैट में अपना UHID नंबर, आधार नंबर, या अपना मोबाइल नंबर न लिखें। अपनी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी की सुरक्षा के लिए इसे केवल अस्पताल के अधिकृत काउंटर पर ही साझा करें।

यदि आपको अधिक सहायता की आवश्यकता हो, तो आप KGMU की हेल्पलाईन नंबर **0522-2258880** या **0522-3539333** पर कॉल कर सकते हैं।
entries.ai_question_translated_en: My UHID number has an incorrect mobile number. How can I correct it?

entries.question: Maine waha par sahi karwaya tha aaj se ek mahine pahle
entries.answer:
यदि आपने एक महीने पहले पंजीकरण काउंटर पर मोबाइल नंबर अपडेट करवाया था और अभी भी समस्या बनी हुई है, तो इसका मतलब है कि या तो सिस्टम में डेटा अपडेट नहीं हुआ या कोई तकनीकी त्रुटि है।

इस स्थिति में आप ये कदम उठाएं:

1. **PRO ऑफिस से संपर्क करें:** आप KGMU के **PRO (Public Relations Office)** में जाएं। वे प्रशासनिक मामलों और रिकॉर्ड सुधारने में आपकी मदद कर सकते हैं।
2. **IT सेल/कंप्यूटर सेक्शन:** आप KGMU के कंप्यूटर पंजीकरण विभाग (IT Cell) में जाकर पूछें कि क्या आपका नंबर डेटाबेस में अपडेट हो गया है। वहां के कर्मचारी आपके UHID को सिस्टम में चेक करके बता सकते हैं कि नंबर क्यों अपडेट नहीं हुआ।
3. **नया पर्चा (OPD Slip):** अगली बार जब आप OPD में आएं, तो पंजीकरण काउंटर पर फिर से अपना सही नंबर अपडेट करने का आग्रह करें और सुनिश्चित करें कि वे आपके सामने इसे सिस्टम में दर्ज कर रहे हैं।
4. **हेल्पलाइन:** आप एक बार KGMU हेल्पलाईन नंबर **0522-2258880** पर कॉल करके अपनी शिकायत दर्ज कराएं कि पहले अपडेट कराने के बावजूद समस्या हल नहीं हुई है।

**नोट:** मैं एक AI सहायक हूँ, मैं सीधे आपके अस्पताल के रिकॉर्ड में बदलाव नहीं कर सकता। कृपया अपनी समस्या को अस्पताल के आधिकारिक अधिकारियों के सामने ही रखें।

*सुरक्षा के लिए, कृपया अपना UHID या अन्य निजी जानकारी इस चैट में बिल्कुल न लिखें।*

entries.question: Online OPD parchi kaise banate hai
entries.answer:
KGMU में ऑनलाइन OPD पर्ची (अपॉइंटमेंट) बुक करने की प्रक्रिया नीचे दी गई है:

**1. ऑनलाइन पोर्टल (ORS) के माध्यम से:**
*   वेबसाइट पर जाएं: [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **लॉगिन/रजिस्टर:** अपने मोबाइल नंबर का उपयोग करके लॉगिन करें (OTP के जरिए)।
*   **राज्य और अस्पताल चुनें:** 'Uttar Pradesh' चुनें और फिर अस्पताल की सूची में से 'King George's Medical University' चुनें।
*   **अपॉइंटमेंट:** 'New Appointment' पर क्लिक करें।
*   **विभाग और तिथि:** जिस विभाग (Department) में दिखाना है उसे चुनें और उपलब्ध तारीख व समय (Time Slot) का चयन करें।
*   **विवरण:** मरीज का नाम, आयु और अन्य जानकारी भरें।
*   **भुगतान:** ₹50 का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें।
*   **पर्ची डाउनलोड:** भुगतान सफल होने के बाद अपॉइंटमेंट स्लिप डाउनलोड कर लें।

**2. मोबाइल ऐप (ABHA / Health Care App):**
*   KGMU Play Store से 'ORS' या 'ABHA' ऐप डाउनलोड करें।
*   अपने मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्टर करें।
*   ORS पोर्टल जैसी ही प्रक्रिया का पालन करके अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करें।

**3. SMS के माध्यम से:**
*   अपने रजिस्टर्ड मोबाइल नंबर से **"APPOINTMENT <मरीज का नाम>"** लिखकर **8887019134** पर SMS भेजें। आपको बुकिंग की पुष्टि का संदेश प्राप्त होगा।

**कुछ जरूरी बातें:**
*   **पंजीकरण शुल्क:** ₹50 (सभी ऑनलाइन माध्यमों के लिए)।
*   **समय:** OPD का समय सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक और शनिवार को सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक होता है।
*   **अस्पताल आने पर:** अपॉइंटमेंट स्लिप का प्रिंटआउट या फोन में डिजिटल कॉपी साथ लेकर आएं और सीधे संबंधित विभाग के काउंटर पर रिपोर्ट करें।

यदि आपको बुकिंग में कोई तकनीकी समस्या आती है, तो आप KGMU की हेल्पलाईन **0522-2258880** या **0522-3539333** पर कॉल कर सकते हैं।

*सुरक्षा के लिए, कृपया इस चैट में अपना मोबाइल नंबर, UHID या आधार नंबर साझा न करें।*

To book an appointment with a cardiologist at KGMU, please follow these steps:

1.  **Online Registration:** KGMU requires mandatory online registration for OPD appointments. Please visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) to book your slot.
2.  **Alternative Booking:**
    *   **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA/Health Care app.
    *   **SMS:** Send an SMS with the text "APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>" to **8887019134**.
    *   **Helpline:** You may call the KGMU appointment helpdesk at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

**Important Notes:**
*   **Department:** When booking, select the **Department of Cardiology**. 
*   **Doctor Availability:** While you can book an appointment for the department, specific consultant availability (like Dr. Akhil Sharma) is subject to the departmental duty roster and OPD schedule. 
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the Cardiology department.
*   **Arrival:** Please arrive early, as the registration counters close at 1:00 PM.
